description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Every Ondo (Ethereum, BNB Chain) and xStocks (Solana) tokenized stock: contract, underlying ticker, on-chain supply, supply value, DEX price vs Chainlink oracle price, premium/discount %. Filters ticker, chain, issuer, limit. Returns JSON per token: contract, underlying ticker, chain, issuer, on-chain supply, supply value, DEX price, Chainlink oracle price, and premium or discount percent.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

chain.description: Optional chain filter. Format: a chain slug. The tool text names ethereum, bsc, and solana. Example: solana. Omit for all of those chains.

issuer.description: Optional issuer filter. Format: a lowercase issuer slug. The tool text names ondo and xstocks. Example: ondo. Omit for both issuers.

limit.description: Maximum tokens to return. Format: positive integer. Example: 20. Omit for the server's current cap.

ticker.description: Optional underlying ticker filter. Format: uppercase ticker, or several separated by commas. Example: TSLA. Omit for every token.

name: tokenized_stocks
title: Tokenized stocks: supply, DEX vs oracle premium ($0.005)
